name: GCM Capital Advisors Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, GCM Capital Advisors Ltd is in the business of trading and investment activities in Shares and Securities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GCMCAL is in the business of financing, trading, and investments in Equity Shares & securities, Commercial Papers, Fixed Deposits, and other related activities of the capital market.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.34 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.97% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -8.47% over last 3 years.
